{c_label}Cooldown:{/c_label} {c_resource}{Cooldown Time}{/c_resource} seconds
Surround yourself with up to {c_number}{SF_0}{/c} protective shadows. Gain {c_number}[{SF_1} * 100|1+%|]{/c} Resistance to All Elements per active shadow. If you have the maximum amount of shadows, direct damage is reduced by {c_number}[{SF_22} * 100|1%|]{/c}. Each time you take direct damage, a shadow is consumed.

Casting {c_important}Dark Shroud{/c} increases your Dodge Chance by {c_number}[{SF_9}*100|%|]{/c} for {c_number}{SF_10}{/c} seconds. While you have at least {c_number}{SF_18}{/c} active shadow from {c_important}Dark Shroud{/c}, gain {c_number}[{SF_11}*100|1%|]{/c} Dodge Chance.
{c_important}Dark Shroud{/c} no longer grants Resistance to All Elements, but instead grants you {c_number}[SF_20*100|x%|]{/c} increased Energy Regeneration per shadow.

When a {c_important}Dark Shroud{/c} shadow is consumed, it explodes in a frigid nova that deals {c_number}{payload:COLD_EXPLOSION_TOOLTIP}{/c} Cold damage to surrounding enemies and {c_important}{u}Chills{/u}{/c} them for {c_number}[{SF_17}|%|]{/c}.
Each active {c_important}Dark Shroud{/c} shadow grants you {c_number}[{SF_5} * 100|%x|]{/c} Movement Speed.
While you have at least {c_number}[{SF_6}]{/c} active shadow from {c_important}Dark Shroud{/c}, gain {c_number}[{SF_4} * 100|%+|]{/c} Critical Strike Chance.
{c_important}Dark Shroud{/c} shadows have a {c_number}[{SF_3} * 100|%|]{/c} chance to not be consumed.
You Heal for {c_number}[{SF_14} * 100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life when a {c_important}Dark Shroud{/c} shadow is consumed.
